coverage.definition: paired_days / days_in_month; a month is usable when both MODIS and VIIRS were requested on >=90% of days, complete only at 100%. This measures successful requests, NOT cloud-free overpass or per-cell observation footprint. Union coverage is reported separately.

gaps.note: Missing = absent from the request manifest, not zero fire. Resume with scripts.firms.fetch_missing.
